## Fejlett, Többágenses Mély Kutatási Rendszer - Teljes Átdolgozás

Az alábbiakban egy jelentősen továbbfejlesztett verziót mutatok be, amely beépíti a 2025-ös legjobb gyakorlatokat a többágenses AI rendszerek építéséhez.[1][2][3]

### Főbb Fejlesztések

A **modern ágenses architektúra** alapelvei szerint az átdolgozott rendszer autonóm, adaptív, célorientált és folyamatosan tanul. A **többágenses rendszerek** kontextus-mérnökséget használnak a komplexitás kezeléséhez, ahol minden ágens specializált szerepkörrel rendelkezik.[2][3]

### Architektúrális Minták

A rendszer **hierarchikus mintát** alkalmaz központi koordinátor ágensessel, amely specializált alegységeket irányít a kutatás, szintézis és validáció terén. A **kontextus-mérnökség** biztosítja, hogy az ágensek megosztott memóriából dolgozzanak, elkerülve az ütköző feltevéseket.[3]

import os

# ===========================
# ENUMERÁCIÓK ÉS TÍPUSOK
# ===========================

class AgentRole(Enum):
    """Ágensek szerepkörei a hierarchikus rendszerben"""
    COORDINATOR = "coordinator"  # Központi koordinátor
    RESEARCHER = "researcher"    # Kutatási specialista
    ANALYZER = "analyzer"        # Elemző specialista
    SYNTHESIZER = "synthesizer"  # Szintetizáló specialista
    VALIDATOR = "validator"      # Validáló specialista
    QUALITY_CHECKER = "quality_checker"  # Minőségellenőrző

class SearchStrategy(Enum):
    """Keresési stratégiák"""
    BROAD = "broad"
    DEEP = "deep"
    LATERAL = "lateral"
    TEMPORAL = "temporal"
    SEMANTIC = "semantic"

class ResearchPhase(Enum):
    """Kutatási fázisok"""
    INITIALIZATION = "initialization"
    EXPLORATION = "exploration"
    DEEP_DIVE = "deep_dive"
    SYNTHESIS = "synthesis"
    VALIDATION = "validation"
    REFINEMENT = "refinement"
    FINALIZATION = "finalization"

# ===========================
# ADATSTRUKTÚRÁK
# ===========================

@dataclass
class SharedContext:
    """Megosztott kontextus az ágensek között - kontextus-mérnökség alapelve"""
    task_id: str
    query: str
    global_assumptions: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    shared_findings: List[Dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    hypotheses: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    decisions: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    
    def compress_context(self, max_findings: int = 50) -> Dict:
        """Kontextus tömörítés - token sprawl elkerülése"""
        return {
            "task_id": self.task_id,
            "query": self.query,
            "global_assumptions": self.global_assumptions,
            "findings_summary": self.shared_findings[:max_findings],
            "hypotheses": self.hypotheses,
            "key_decisions": self.decisions
        }

@dataclass
class AgentMessage:
    """Ágensek közötti üzenet"""
    sender: AgentRole
    receiver: AgentRole
    message_type: str
    content: Any
    timestamp: float = field(default_factory=time.time)
    context_snapshot: Optional[Dict] = None

@dataclass
class ResearchState:
    """Kutatási állapot fejlett nyomon követéssel"""
    task_id: str
    query: str
    start_time: float
    current_phase: ResearchPhase
    max_depth: int
    findings: List[Dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    hypotheses: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    searches_performed: int = 0
    agent_interactions: List[Dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    quality_metrics: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)
    status: str = "running"
    final_report: Optional[str] = None
    phase_history: List[Tuple[ResearchPhase, float]] = field(default_factory=list)

@dataclass
class Finding:
    """Fejlett találat struktúra metaadatokkal"""
    url: str
    title: str
    text: str
    source_type: str
    confidence_score: float
    relevance_score: float
    timestamp: float
    agent_id: str
    search_strategy: SearchStrategy
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    validation_status: str = "pending"

# ===========================
# ABSZTRAKT ÁGENSEK ALAPOSZTÁLYA
# ===========================

class BaseAgent(ABC):
    """Absztrakt ágnes alaposztály a SOLID elvek szerint"""
    
    def __init__(self, role: AgentRole, shared_context: SharedContext, llm_clients: Dict):
        self.role = role
        self.shared_context = shared_context
        self.llm_clients = llm_clients
        self.logger = logging.getLogger(f"{__name__}.{role.value}")
        self.memory = []
        
    @abstractmethod
    async def execute(self, task: Dict) -> Dict:
        """Ágnes fő végrehajtási logikája"""
        pass
    
    def update_shared_context(self, key: str, value: Any):
        """Biztonságos megosztott kontextus frissítés"""
        self.shared_context.decisions[key] = {
            "value": value,
            "agent": self.role.value,
            "timestamp": time.time()
        }
        
    def get_scoped_context(self, context_type: str) -> Dict:
        """Kontextus izolálás - csak a szükséges információk"""
        compressed = self.shared_context.compress_context()
        
        if context_type == "research":
            return {
                "query": compressed["query"],
                "global_assumptions": compressed["global_assumptions"],
                "hypotheses": compressed["hypotheses"]
            }
        elif context_type == "synthesis":
            return {
                "query": compressed["query"],
                "findings_summary": compressed["findings_summary"],
                "key_decisions": compressed["key_decisions"]
            }
        return compressed

# ===========================
# SPECIALIZÁLT ÁGENSEK
# ===========================

class CoordinatorAgent(BaseAgent):
    """Központi koordinátor ágnes - hierarchikus minta"""
    
    async def execute(self, task: Dict) -> Dict:
        """Koordinálja az alegységek munkáját"""
        self.logger.info(f"Koordinátor indítása: {task.get('phase')}")
        
        phase = task.get("phase", ResearchPhase.EXPLORATION)
        
        # Fázis-specifikus stratégia
        if phase == ResearchPhase.EXPLORATION:
            return await self._coordinate_exploration()
        elif phase == ResearchPhase.DEEP_DIVE:
            return await self._coordinate_deep_dive()
        elif phase == ResearchPhase.SYNTHESIS:
            return await self._coordinate_synthesis()
        
        return {"status": "completed", "phase": phase.value}
    
    async def _coordinate_exploration(self) -> Dict:
        """Feltárási fázis koordinálása"""
        prompt = f"""Mint fő koordinátor, tervezd meg a kutatási stratégiát:

Téma: {self.shared_context.query}

Add meg JSON formátumban:
1. primary_strategies: Lista a használandó keresési stratégiákról
2. research_angles: Különböző kutatási nézőpontok
3. priority_sources: Prioritást élvező forrástípusok
4. initial_hypotheses: 5 kezdeti hipotézis
"""
        
        response = await self._call_thinking_model(prompt)
        try:
            plan = json.loads(response)
            self.update_shared_context("exploration_plan", plan)
            return plan
        except:
            return {"status": "error", "message": "Parsing failed"}
    
    async def _coordinate_deep_dive(self) -> Dict:
        """Mélyreható kutatás koordinálása"""
        findings_count = len(self.shared_context.shared_findings)
        
        prompt = f"""Elemezd a jelenlegi kutatási állapotot és határozd meg a következő lépéseket:

Találatok száma: {findings_count}
Hipotézisek: {json.dumps(self.shared_context.hypotheses[:10], ensure_ascii=False)}

Add meg JSON formátumban:
1. next_research_targets: Következő kutatási célpontok
2. hypothesis_to_test: Tesztelendő hipotézis
3. search_queries: 5 specifikus keresési kérdés
"""
        
        response = await self._call_thinking_model(prompt)
        try:
            plan = json.loads(response)
            self.update_shared_context("deep_dive_plan", plan)
            return plan
        except:
            return {"status": "error"}
    
    async def _coordinate_synthesis(self) -> Dict:
        """Szintézis fázis koordinálása"""
        self.update_shared_context("synthesis_started", True)
        return {"status": "synthesis_ready"}
    
    async def _call_thinking_model(self, prompt: str) -> str:
        """Gondolkodó modell hívása"""
        cerebras = self.llm_clients.get("cerebras")
        response = cerebras.chat.completions.create(
            model="llama-3.3-70b",
            messages=[
                {"role": "system", "content": "Ön szakértő kutatási koordinátor. JSON formátumban válaszoljon."},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt}
            ],
            max_tokens=8192,
            temperature=0.8
        )
        return response.choices[0].message.content

class ResearcherAgent(BaseAgent):
    """Kutatási specialista ágnes"""
    
    def __init__(self, role: AgentRole, shared_context: SharedContext, llm_clients: Dict, exa_client: Exa):
        super().__init__(role, shared_context, llm_clients)
        self.exa = exa_client
        self.search_cache = {}
        
    async def execute(self, task: Dict) -> Dict:
        """Kutatási feladatok végrehajtása"""
        strategy = task.get("strategy", SearchStrategy.BROAD)
        queries = task.get("queries", [self.shared_context.query])
        
        all_findings = []
        
        for query in queries:
            # Cache ellenőrzés
            cache_key = hashlib.md5(query.encode()).hexdigest()
            if cache_key in self.search_cache:
                self.logger.info(f"Cache találat: {query}")
                all_findings.extend(self.search_cache[cache_key])
                continue
            
            if strategy == SearchStrategy.BROAD:
                findings = await self._broad_search(query)
            elif strategy == SearchStrategy.DEEP:
                findings = await self._deep_search(query)
            elif strategy == SearchStrategy.LATERAL:
                findings = await self._lateral_search(query)
            elif strategy == SearchStrategy.SEMANTIC:
                findings = await self._semantic_search(query)
            
            self.search_cache[cache_key] = findings
            all_findings.extend(findings)
            
            # Shared context frissítés
            self.shared_context.shared_findings.extend(findings)
            
        return {
            "status": "completed",
            "findings_count": len(all_findings),
            "strategy": strategy.value
        }
    
    async def _broad_search(self, query: str) -> List[Dict]:
        """Széles körű keresés"""
        findings = []
        
        for category in [None, "news", "research paper", "company"]:
            try:
                response = self.exa.search_and_contents(
                    query=query,
                    type="auto",
                    num_results=50,
                    text=True,
                    highlights=True,
                    category=category,
                    livecrawl="preferred"
                )
                
                for result in response.results:
                    finding = Finding(
                        url=result.url,
                        title=result.title,
                        text=result.text if hasattr(result, 'text') else "",
                        source_type=category or "general",
                        confidence_score=0.7,
                        relevance_score=0.8,
                        timestamp=time.time(),
                        agent_id=f"{self.role.value}",
                        search_strategy=SearchStrategy.BROAD,
                        metadata={
                            "highlights": result.highlights if hasattr(result, 'highlights') else [],
                            "published_date": result.published_date if hasattr(result, 'published_date') else None
                        }
                    )
                    findings.append(asdict(finding))
                    
            except Exception as e:
                self.logger.error(f"Keresési hiba ({category}): {e}")
                
        return findings
    
    async def _deep_search(self, query: str) -> List[Dict]:
        """Mélyreható keresés podobjects kapcsolatokkal"""
        findings = []
        
        try:
            # Első szintű keresés
            response = self.exa.search_and_contents(
                query=query,
                type="auto",
                num_results=20,
                text=True,
                highlights=True
            )
            
            for result in response.results:
                finding = Finding(
                    url=result.url,
                    title=result.title,
                    text=result.text if hasattr(result, 'text') else "",
                    source_type="deep",
                    confidence_score=0.85,
                    relevance_score=0.9,
                    timestamp=time.time(),
                    agent_id=f"{self.role.value}",
                    search_strategy=SearchStrategy.DEEP
                )
                findings.append(asdict(finding))
                
                # Hasonló dokumentumok keresése
                try:
                    similar_response = self.exa.find_similar_and_contents(
                        url=result.url,
                        num_results=10,
                        text=True,
                        exclude_source_domain=True
                    )
                    
                    for sim_result in similar_response.results:
                        sim_finding = Finding(
                            url=sim_result.url,
                            title=sim_result.title,
                            text=sim_result.text if hasattr(sim_result, 'text') else "",
                            source_type="similar",
                            confidence_score=0.75,
                            relevance_score=0.85,
                            timestamp=time.time(),
                            agent_id=f"{self.role.value}",
                            search_strategy=SearchStrategy.DEEP,
                            metadata={"parent_url": result.url}
                        )
                        findings.append(asdict(sim_finding))
                        
                except Exception as e:
                    self.logger.error(f"Hasonló keresés hiba: {e}")
                    
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"Mélykeresés hiba: {e}")
            
        return findings
    
    async def _lateral_search(self, query: str) -> List[Dict]:
        """Laterális gondolkodás-alapú keresés"""
        # Generálunk alternatív keresési kifejezéseket
        prompt = f"""Generálj 5 kreatív, laterális keresési kérdést ehhez a témához:
        
{query}

Gondolkodj a témán kívül, keress kapcsolódó területeket, analógiákat, alternatív perspektívákat.
Add meg csak a kérdéseket, soronként egyet."""

        cerebras = self.llm_clients.get("cerebras")
        response = cerebras.chat.completions.create(
            model="llama-3.3-70b",
            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
            max_tokens=1024,
            temperature=1.0
        )
        
        lateral_queries = [q.strip() for q in response.choices[0].message.content.split('\n') if q.strip()]
        
        findings = []
        for lat_query in lateral_queries[:3]:
            try:
                response = self.exa.search_and_contents(
                    query=lat_query,
                    type="auto",
                    num_results=10,
                    text=True
                )
                
                for result in response.results:
                    finding = Finding(
                        url=result.url,
                        title=result.title,
                        text=result.text if hasattr(result, 'text') else "",
                        source_type="lateral",
                        confidence_score=0.6,
                        relevance_score=0.7,
                        timestamp=time.time(),
                        agent_id=f"{self.role.value}",
                        search_strategy=SearchStrategy.LATERAL,
                        metadata={"lateral_query": lat_query}
                    )
                    findings.append(asdict(finding))
                    
            except Exception as e:
                self.logger.error(f"Laterális keresés hiba: {e}")
                
        return findings
    
    async def _semantic_search(self, query: str) -> List[Dict]:
        """Szemantikus keresés neurális alapokon"""
        findings = []
        
        try:
            response = self.exa.search_and_contents(
                query=query,
                type="neural",
                num_results=30,
                text=True,
                highlights=True,
                use_autoprompt=True
            )
            
            for result in response.results:
                finding = Finding(
                    url=result.url,
                    title=result.title,
                    text=result.text if hasattr(result, 'text') else "",
                    source_type="semantic",
                    confidence_score=0.8,
                    relevance_score=0.85,
                    timestamp=time.time(),
                    agent_id=f"{self.role.value}",
                    search_strategy=SearchStrategy.SEMANTIC
                )
                findings.append(asdict(finding))
                
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"Szemantikus keresés hiba: {e}")
            
        return findings

class AnalyzerAgent(BaseAgent):
    """Elemző specialista ágnes"""
    
    async def execute(self, task: Dict) -> Dict:
        """Találatok elemzése és relevanciájuk értékelése"""
        findings = task.get("findings", self.shared_context.shared_findings[-100:])
        
        analyzed_findings = []
        
        for finding in findings:
            analysis = await self._analyze_finding(finding)
            finding["analysis"] = analysis
            finding["relevance_score"] = analysis.get("relevance", 0.5)
            finding["confidence_score"] = analysis.get("confidence", 0.5)
            analyzed_findings.append(finding)
        
        # Rangsorolás relevancia szerint
        analyzed_findings.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("relevance_score", 0), reverse=True)
        
        self.update_shared_context("analyzed_findings", analyzed_findings[:50])
        
        return {
            "status": "completed",
            "analyzed_count": len(analyzed_findings),
            "top_relevance": analyzed_findings[0].get("relevance_score") if analyzed_findings else 0
        }
    
    async def _analyze_finding(self, finding: Dict) -> Dict:
        """Egyedi találat elemzése"""
        text_snippet = finding.get("text", "")[:1000]
        
        prompt = f"""Elemezd ezt a kutatási találatot a következő szempont szerint:

Kutatási téma: {self.shared_context.query}

Találat címe: {finding.get('title')}
Szöveg részlet: {text_snippet}

Add meg JSON formátumban:
1. relevance: 0-1 közötti relevancia score
2. confidence: 0-1 közötti megbízhatósági score
3. key_insights: Lista a főbb felismerésekről (max 3)
4. contradictions: Ellentmondások vagy problémák
"""
        
        try:
            cerebras = self.llm_clients.get("cerebras")
            response = cerebras.chat.completions.create(
                model="llama-3.3-70b",
                messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
                max_tokens=1024,
                temperature=0.5
            )
            
            return json.loads(response.choices[0].message.content)
        except:
            return {"relevance": 0.5, "confidence": 0.5, "key_insights": [], "contradictions": []}

class SynthesizerAgent(BaseAgent):
    """Szintetizáló specialista ágnes"""
    
    async def execute(self, task: Dict) -> Dict:
        """Találatok szintézise koherens narratívába"""
        context = self.get_scoped_context("synthesis")
        findings = context.get("findings_summary", [])
        
        synthesis = await self._synthesize_findings(findings)
        
        self.update_shared_context("synthesis_result", synthesis)
        
        return {
            "status": "completed",
            "synthesis_length": len(synthesis),
            "sections": synthesis.get("sections", [])
        }
    
    async def _synthesize_findings(self, findings: List[Dict]) -> Dict:
        """Találatok szintézise"""
        findings_text = "\n\n".join([
            f"[{i+1}] {f.get('title', 'Címtelen')}\n{f.get('text', '')[:500]}..."
            for i, f in enumerate(findings[:50])
        ])
        
        prompt = f"""Szintetizáld ezeket a kutatási találatokat átfogó elemzéssé:

Kutatási téma: {self.shared_context.query}

Találatok:
{findings_text}

Add meg JSON formátumban:
1. main_themes: Főbb témák listája
2. key_patterns: Azonosított minták
3. contradictions: Ellentmondások vagy hiányosságok
4. insights: Legfontosabb felismerések (5-7 db)
5. knowledge_gaps: További kutatást igénylő területek
6. executive_summary: 3-4 mondatos összefoglaló
"""
        
        try:
            claude = self.llm_clients.get("claude")
            response = claude.messages.create(
                model="us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0",
                messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
                max_tokens=8192,
                temperature=0.7
            )
            
            synthesis = json.loads(response.content[0].text)
            return synthesis
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"Szintézis hiba: {e}")
            return {"status": "error", "message": str(e)}

class ValidatorAgent(BaseAgent):
    """Validáló specialista ágnes"""
    
    async def execute(self, task: Dict) -> Dict:
        """Kutatási eredmények validálása"""
        synthesis = self.shared_context.decisions.get("synthesis_result", {}).get("value", {})
        
        validation = await self._validate_synthesis(synthesis)
        
        self.update_shared_context("validation_result", validation)
        
        return {
            "status": "completed",
            "validation_score": validation.get("overall_score", 0),
            "issues_found": len(validation.get("issues", []))
        }
    
    async def _validate_synthesis(self, synthesis: Dict) -> Dict:
        """Szintézis validálása"""
        prompt = f"""Validáld ezt a kutatási szintézist:

Téma: {self.shared_context.query}

Szintézis: {json.dumps(synthesis, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)}

Ellenőrizd:
1. Logikai konzisztencia
2. Bizonyítékok megfelelősége
3. Ellentmondások azonosítása
4. Hiányosságok feltárása

Add meg JSON formátumban:
1. overall_score: 0-1 közötti összesített pontszám
2. strengths: Erősségek listája
3. issues: Problémák/hiányosságok listája
4. recommendations: Javaslatok a javításhoz
"""
        
        try:
            claude = self.llm_clients.get("claude")
            response = claude.messages.create(
                model="us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0",
                messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
                max_tokens=4096,
                temperature=0.5
            )
            
            return json.loads(response.content[0].text)
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"Validálás hiba: {e}")
            return {"overall_score": 0.5, "issues": ["Validálási hiba történt"]}

class MultiAgentOrchestrator:
    """Központi orchestrátor a többágenses rendszerhez"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self._initialize_clients()
        self.active_tasks = {}
        
    def _initialize_clients(self):
        """LLM kliensek inicializálása"""
        self.exa = Exa(api_key=os.environ.get("EXA_API_KEY"))

request_id_var: ContextVar[Optional[str]] = ContextVar('request_id', default=None)
user_id_var: ContextVar[Optional[str]] = ContextVar('user_id', default=None)


class CustomJsonFormatter(jsonlogger.JsonFormatter):
    """Custom JSON formatter with additional fields"""
    
    def add_fields(self, log_record: Dict[str, Any], record: logging.LogRecord, message_dict: Dict[str, Any]):
        """Add custom fields to log record"""
        super().add_fields(log_record, record, message_dict)
        
        # Add timestamp
        log_record['timestamp'] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        
        # Add log level
        log_record['level'] = record.levelname
        
        # Add logger name
        log_record['logger'] = record.name
        
        # Add module and function
        log_record['module'] = record.module
        log_record['function'] = record.funcName
        
        # Add file and line
        log_record['file'] = record.pathname
        log_record['line'] = record.lineno
        
        # Add context from ContextVar
        request_id = request_id_var.get()
        if request_id:
            log_record['request_id'] = request_id
        
        user_id = user_id_var.get()
        if user_id:
            log_record['user_id'] = user_id
        
        # Add environment
        log_record['environment'] = settings.ENVIRONMENT
        
        # Add application info
        log_record['app_name'] = settings.APP_NAME
        log_record['app_version'] = settings.VERSION


class ContextFilter(logging.Filter):
    """Filter to add context to log records"""
    
    def filter(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> bool:
        """Add context variables to record"""
        record.request_id = request_id_var.get() or 'N/A'
        record.user_id = user_id_var.get() or 'N/A'
        return True


def setup_logging():
    """Setup production logging configuration"""
    
    # Create logs directory
    log_dir = Path(settings.LOG_FILE).parent
    log_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    
    # Root logger
    root_logger = logging.getLogger()
    root_logger.setLevel(getattr(logging, settings.LOG_LEVEL))
    
    # Remove existing handlers
    root_logger.handlers = []
    
    # Console handler
    console_handler = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout)
    console_handler.setLevel(getattr(logging, settings.LOG_LEVEL))
    
    if settings.LOG_FORMAT == "json":
        console_formatter = CustomJsonFormatter(
            '%(timestamp)s %(level)s %(name)s %(message)s'
        )
    else:
        console_formatter = logging.Formatter(
            '%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s'
        )
    
    console_handler.setFormatter(console_formatter)
    console_handler.addFilter(ContextFilter())
    root_logger.addHandler(console_handler)
    
    # File handler with rotation
    file_handler = logging.handlers.RotatingFileHandler(
        settings.LOG_FILE,
        maxBytes=settings.LOG_MAX_BYTES,
        backupCount=settings.LOG_BACKUP_COUNT,
        encoding='utf-8'
    )

        results = await asyncio.gather(*analysis_tasks)
        
        analyzed_findings = []
        for batch_result in results:
            analyzed_findings.extend(batch_result)
        
        analyzed_findings.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("relevance_score", 0), reverse=True)
        
        self.update_context("analyzed_findings", analyzed_findings[:100])
        
        return {
            "status": "completed",
            "analyzed_count": len(analyzed_findings),
            "avg_relevance": sum(f.get("relevance_score", 0) for f in analyzed_findings) / max(len(analyzed_findings), 1)
        }
    
    async def analyze_batch(self, batch: List[Dict]) -> List[Dict]:
        analyzed = []
        for finding in batch:
            analysis = await self.analyze_finding(finding)
            finding["analysis"] = analysis
            finding["relevance_score"] = analysis.get("relevance", 0.5)
            finding["confidence_score"] = analysis.get("confidence", 0.5)
            finding["key_claims"] = analysis.get("key_claims", [])
            analyzed.append(finding)
        return analyzed
    
    async def analyze_finding(self, finding: Dict) -> Dict:
        text_snippet = finding.get("text", "")[:1500]
        
        prompt = f"""Analyze this research finding:

Query: {self.shared_context.query}

Title: {finding.get('title', 'No title')}
Text: {text_snippet}

Provide JSON with:
1. relevance: 0-1 score
2. confidence: 0-1 score
3. key_claims: list of main claims (max 5)
4. contradictions: any contradictory statements
5. entities: mentioned entities

Return only valid JSON."""
        
        try:

            return json.loads(response)
        except:
            return {
                "relevance": 0.5,

            }

class HypothesisGeneratorAgent(BaseAgent):

            "hypotheses_count": len(hypotheses)
        }
    
    async def generate_hypotheses(self, findings: List[Dict]) -> List[str]:
        findings_summary = "\n".join([
            f"- {f.get('title', 'No title')}"
            for f in findings[:30]
        ])
        
        prompt = f"""Based on these research findings, generate 10 new hypotheses to investigate:

Query: {self.shared_context.query}

Current findings:
{findings_summary}

Generate specific, testable hypotheses that would deepen understanding.
Return as numbered list, one per line."""
        
        response = await self.call_cerebras_fast(prompt, temperature=0.9)
        
        hypotheses = []
        for line in response.split('\n'):
            if line.strip() and any(c.isalpha() for c in line):
                cleaned = line.strip().lstrip('0123456789.-) ')
                if cleaned and len(cleaned) > 10:
                    hypotheses.append(cleaned)
        
        return hypotheses[:10]

class ContradictionDetectorAgent(BaseAgent):
    async def execute(self, task: Dict) -> Dict:
        findings = self.shared_context.global_findings[-200:]
        
        contradictions = await self.detect_contradictions(findings)

        self.update_context("contradictions", contradictions)
        
        return {
            "status": "completed",
            "contradictions_found": len(contradictions)
        }
    
    async def detect_contradictions(self, findings: List[Dict]) -> List[Dict]:
        claims_by_finding = []
        
        for finding in findings[:50]:
            if finding.get("key_claims"):
                claims_by_finding.append({
                    "source": finding.get("title", "Unknown"),
                    "url": finding.get("url", ""),
                    "claims": finding.get("key_claims", [])
                })
        
        if len(claims_by_finding) < 2:
            return []
        
        claims_text = "\n\n".join([
            f"Source: {item['source']}\nClaims:\n" + "\n".join(f"- {c}" for c in item['claims'])
            for item in claims_by_finding[:20]
        ])
        
        prompt = f"""Identify contradictions between these sources:

Query: {self.shared_context.query}

{claims_text}

Find statements that directly contradict each other.
Provide JSON array with: source1, source2, claim1, claim2, contradiction_description

Return only valid JSON array."""
        
        try:
            response = await self.call_cerebras_fast(prompt, max_tokens=4096)
            contradictions = json.loads(response)
            return contradictions if isinstance(contradictions, list) else []
        except:
            return []

                except:
                    pass
            if data:

        except Exception as e:

            const entry = document.createElement('div');
            entry.className = 'log-entry';
            const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
            entry.innerHTML = `<span class="log-time">${time}</span><strong>${phase}:</strong> ${message}`;

                    updateProgress(data.phase);
                    document.getElementById('statusMessage').textContent = data.message;
                    addLog(data.message, data.phase.replace(/_/g, ' ').toUpperCase());

                addLog('Connection error occurred', 'Error');
            };

                console.log('WebSocket closed');
            };
        }

@app.post("/api/research/start", response_model=ResearchResponse)
async def start_research(request: ResearchRequest, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks):
    task_id = f"task_{int(time.time())}_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    
    active_researches[task_id] = {
        "status": "running",
        "topic": request.topic,
        "start_time": time.time()
    }
    
    async def run_research_task():
        try:
            report = await orchestrator.run_research(request.topic, task_id)
            active_researches[task_id]["status"] = "completed"
            active_researches[task_id]["report"] = report
            active_researches[task_id]["end_time"] = time.time()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Research error: {e}", exc_info=True)
            active_researches[task_id]["status"] = "error"
            active_researches[task_id]["error"] = str(e)
    
    background_tasks.add_task(run_research_task)
    
    return ResearchResponse(
        task_id=task_id,
        status="started",
        message="Multi-agent research initiated"
    )

    await manager.connect(websocket)

        if task_id in active_researches and active_researches[task_id]["status"] == "running":
            await orchestrator.run_research(
                active_researches[task_id]["topic"],
                task_id,
                websocket
            )
        
        while True:
            await websocket.receive_text()
            
    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        manager.disconnect(websocket)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"WebSocket error: {e}")
        manager.disconnect(websocket)
